remark: No opening date stated. FS page says 16 of 35 sites reservable (recreation.gov and the note say 12); remainder first-come.

quote: Seasons of Use Open Year round
remark: recreation.gov Overview also says "Walk-ins are accepted year-round."; FS page: "Campground Host available during the reservation season." Calendar edge is the end of reservations. booking lacks fcfs (walk-ins accepted).
Chip lacks the opening edge. Page: "9 reservable sites and 2 first come first serve sites"; campground redesigned 2023 as an OHV campground, site numbers changed.

quote: Seasons of Use April 17 - October 15 Operational Hours Typically stays open from Memorial Day to Labor Day
remark: Page gives two seasons for both edges: Seasons of Use April 17 - October 15 (closes matches chip) vs Operational Hours Memorial Day to Labor Day (holiday-anchored). Both edges left out.

quote: Seasons of Use May 23 - October 15 Operational Hours Typically stays open from Memorial Day to Labor Day
remark: Opening agrees (May 23 / Memorial Day, holiday-anchored). Closing conflicts on the page: Seasons of Use October 15 (matches chip) vs Operational Hours Labor Day (09-07), so closes left out of agency_season.

quote: Anticipated closure date for the season is October 11, 2026
remark: Page also says "Seasons of Use May - October" and "The campground is generally open between Memorial Day Weekend and mid-October. These dates are affected by snow conditions." Opens = Memorial Day (holiday-anchored; month-level line says May); closes from the dated 2026 closure (mid-October agrees; month-level line says October). Boat-ramp RV camping sites 69-81 also offered.
Same page: "Seasons of Use May 16, through October 12, 2025." (opens from this). "33 of the 71 campsites can be reserved" - rest first-come; booking lacks fcfs.
No opening date stated. "17 of the 38 campsites may be reserved" - rest first-come; booking lacks fcfs.
"Most single family sites and group campgrounds can be reserved" - so some are first-come.

BLM page states no season. recreation.gov facility 255118 is "Lower Onion Creek Group Sites" only - its calendar (02-10 to 11-30) is the group sites' window. BLM: "Individual sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis"; booking says reservable/fcfs some_sites, but the 21 individual sites are first-come only. Group-site parking: no RVs or pickup/trailer combinations over 22 feet.
